project_overview: CCTNS V1.0 is a police case management system focusing on crime investigation and criminal detection, providing value to police personnel and citizens.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: System administrator with full access rights

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Complainant or public user reporting cases

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff handling defects and enhancement requests

functions.name: RegisterCase
functions.description: Citizens can register complaints with police
acceptance_criteria: Case is created with all required fields
Citizen receives confirmation of case registration

functions.name: InvestigateCase
functions.description: Police initiates investigation process after complaint registration
acceptance_criteria: Case status is updated to 'Under Investigation'
All investigation actions are recorded in audit trail

functions.name: SearchCase
functions.description: Search for cases with various criteria
acceptance_criteria: Search results are returned within performance requirements
Only cases with proper access rights are shown
functions.preconditions: User must have appropriate access rights

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Track submitted defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: Defect status updates are visible to submitter
Help desk can generate reports on defects

functions.name: ExportAuditTrail
functions.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit data is exported without affecting stored trail
Exported data contains all required information

constraints.description: Provide context-sensitive help for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.
The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word "unalterable" is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Track events automatically in audit trail
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: Allow limiting case access to specific users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Only admins can set up user profiles
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: Retrieve recently accessed cases within 5-8 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.
The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

exceptions.trigger: User tries to access case without proper rights
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail, show appropriate error message
Inform user and suggest alternative search criteria
Continue operation in offline mode with limited functionality

non_functional_requirements.description: System must provide adequate response times under standard and peak conditions
System must prevent SQL injection and cross-site scripting
System must be available during specified hours with minimal downtime
User interfaces must comply with ISO 9241 standards
System must work in small and large police stations
